items.requirement: Clean install, repeatable migration, atomic seed, build, API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI run through published commands.
OpenAPI, strict errors, tenant isolation, frozen terms, cursor, seed, and snapshot match the public contract.
Trial uniqueness, activation, upgrade, scheduled downgrade, renewal, cancellation, and expiry create one legal timeline and non-overlapping grants.
Duplicate, unknown, reordered, and concurrent refunds never exceed the frozen charge and full refund revokes once.
Revocation fences are monotonic, visible within two seconds, and worker/outbox recovery cannot restore access or duplicate events.
V1 subscriptions, grants, fences, provider events, audit, work, and replay survive FINAL migration.
Pool capacity, expected version, over-limit behavior, assignment races, and subscription-driven revocation preserve V1 compatibility.
All three sustained scenarios meet thresholds and every post-load access and conservation invariant.
Project owns substantive unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Codex explains ownership, lifecycle, fences, races, and review findings clearly.
Handoff reports actual commands, metrics, risks, and unrun checks without overclaiming.
